answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 10819 Country: India Title: assalamualikum WHAT ISLAM SAY ABOUT BEARD IT IS HARAM TO SHAVE THE BEARDTO GROW THE BEARD IS WAJIB SEND FATWA PLEASE IN DETAILS AND MENTION THE LEANTH OF BEARD IN SHARIAT KHUDAHAFIZ Question: assalamualikum WHAT ISLAM SAY ABOUT BEARD IT IS HARAM TO SHAVE THE BEARDTO GROW THE BEARD IS WAJIB SEND FATWA PLEASE IN DETAILS AND MENTION THE LEANTH OF BEARD IN SHARIAT KHUDAHAFIZ Answer ID: 10819 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 207/207=M/1430) Islam commands to keep beard and regards trimming it below one fist as unlawful and haram. It is wajib (necessary) to grow beard and not to trim it below one fist. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
